chunks: So enter the gates of Hell to abide in it for ever. How evil the abode of the arrogant!
ai.seo_question: Who are the arrogant (al-mutakabbirun) destined for Hell according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the ultimate fate of those who rejected Imam Ali (AS) and the Ahl al-Bayt, viewing their arrogance as a rejection of divine authority. The term 'al-mutakabbirun' specifically denotes those who elevated themselves above the truth, a concept central to the narrative of Qarun and Pharaoh. This eternal dwelling emphasizes the permanence of the consequence for those who maintained their pride until death.
